releases.name: Alchemy Factory
releases.summary:
A medieval sandbox blending alchemy, automation & shopkeeping!

As a magic apprentice, build your empire of automated production lines crafting potions, metals, and jewels. Rise from a humble shop owner to an industry-dominating alchemy magnate!

releases.name: Pegture
releases.summary: Pegture is a peg solitaire-themed roguelike, deck-building game. Build your deck, enhance your pegs, perform frenetic combos, beat bosses, reach the highest score and get the best peg solitaire experience.

releases.name: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
releases.summary: Honeycomb: The World Beyond is a survival-sandbox game set on an exuberant planet – Sota7. Explore its vast world and face challenges on your bioengineering journey. Crossbreed plants or animals, gather resources, craft items, and conduct experiments in order to develop new species.

releases.name: Bus Simulator 27
releases.summary:
Get ready for Bus Simulator 27, the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise. Look forward to our most comprehensive bus fleet yet - with new officially licensed brands and models, as well as iconic buses from the series.

Explore a vibrant new open world inspired by the Iberian Peninsula, featuring distinct districts, busy streets, and impressive landmarks - all brought to life with Unreal Engine 5.

Whether you're behind the wheel, walking the streets or riding as a passenger, the city is yours to discover. Plan custom routes and manage your growing business.

Play solo or team up with friends in 4-player co-operative mode.

releases.name: Desk Top Racer
releases.summary: Turn your desktop into a living racetrack with this idle racing management game. Acquire cars, equip parts, and compete online against other players. Win championships and expand your garage through Mastery, Collections, and new rewards.

releases.name: Elder Gate
releases.summary: Learning with Hippo presents First Spanish words. Spanish is the official language—either de facto or de jure in countries like Spain, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Cuba, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Uruguay, Venezuela, Peru, Equatorial Guinea etc. This app offers an exciting set of educational games for your child (even adults) to learn Spanish words through a variety of exercises for learning the alphabet, Animals, colors and much more.Let your kids explore different illustrative picture while improving their reading skills. The simple and intuitive user interface is designed to be kids friendly, which allows children to play without help from an adult.-----------------------------------------How to play: Drag and drop to arrange the letters in the correct order to make up a word.----------------------------------------Expect your kids to improve in all of the following areas:• Reading• Animal recognition• Colors recognition• Fruits and vegetable recognition and much more• Memory skills• Fine motor skills (in toddlers)• Increased motivation to read and learn• Phonics: kids learn how to blend the phonic sounds to form words.There are six different settings for increased difficulty. Each word has a clear Native Audio, which reads out the correct pronunciation. This is very important for a child's learning. The user-friendly interface allows kids to learn fast. This is a universal appWe made considerable effort to ensure that the design of this app is easy-to-use for this kids and that the whole app is as educational and fun as possible. We hope that your children will enjoy it the same way our little beta-testers did!Teach your child to read and write the easy way!

releases.name: TAMA JIGOKU
releases.summary: Another great casino old school simulation!!!!Now you can play the most famous slot machine with no money to have great fun with your friends.Features :- Bonus 5 of a kind on 3 positions- Bonus All symbols with free spins- Change which symbol to carry- Bet 50 / 100 / 200- Payout to get HighScore- HighScore can be posted on own Facebook WallThe game will be updated regularly, so suggest us improvements and notice us bugs on our forum.Enjoy!

releases.name: Surviving Mars: Relaunched - Feeding the Future
releases.summary:
Your colonists are hungry for more than survival. Provide your colonists with various delicacies and build local production to create the ultimate Martian diet in Surviving Mars: Relaunched - Feeding the Future.

After all, survival comes in many flavors! 

Combine your ingredients into gastronomical wonders. Food service buildings still feed colonists but can now also add delicacies that affect colonist comfort, morale, health, and sanity. What are sugar, bread, butter, and cheese if not Comfort enhancers? A poorly fed colony can survive - but invest in your menus and your colonists will thrive!

releases.name: Baryum
releases.summary: A first-person space sim set in the real solar system at true scale, with every planet where it actually is today. Dock at the ISS, take contracts, survey planets, mine moons, haul cargo and fight pirates across genuine interplanetary distances as you rise from cadet to major.

releases.name: TOWERPULSE
releases.summary: It's time to be Top Gun and Pilot your Airforce Helicopter through the desert!Blast your way destroying all the incoming air traffic and collect the weapon drops to upgrade your way to the fighter jet.Need some intense high speed desert warfare action? Your cleared for take off!Game Center enabled to challenge your friends to an air battle.

releases.name: OminouSushi
releases.summary: A quiet anomaly slips onto the conveyor belt. Drop sushi, merge matching pieces, and evolve them as you chase a high score—but “ominous sushi” arrive without warning. Spot them before they fall, or the belt speeds up toward game over. Merge, observe, and trust no sushi.

releases.name: Voldark
releases.summary: Voldark is an open-world survival crafting game set in a dangerous forest filled with mutant creatures. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, level up your character, build and defend your base while surviving relentless nighttime attacks.

releases.name: TRUDGE
releases.summary: A slow, minimalist psychological pixel experience about living the same empty routine in a silent city. Wake up. Work. Eat. Sleep. Beneath the depressing monotony and liminal surroundings, something slowly begins to break.

releases.name: Trouble Thief
releases.summary: Steal your way through 30 levels. Just pick up the loot and carry it back to the safe zone, no problem. Each level has very challenging time trials and a no-hit challenge. The game is mainly designed around beating the levels as fast as possible.

releases.name: Underkeep (chris lee)
releases.summary: The military special forces have elite snipers trained for combat. You alone must eliminate the hostile threat and return the hostages to safety! Can you save them and save yourself?Battle your friends across the Game Center Leaderboards!
